observations: PPN 017 applies to central government departments, executive agencies and non-departmental public bodies; other public buyers may adopt the approach.
Suppliers may use AI to prepare bids; the PPN provides optional disclosure questions for information only, not automatically scored.
Example questions ask whether AI assisted tender submissions and whether generated responses were checked for accuracy.
The policy warns about plausible but inaccurate LLM-generated content and recommends proportionate due diligence.
